# apim_api_link (Resource)

APILink Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apim_api_link" "external-docs" {
  api_hrid   = "petstore-api"
  hrid       = "external-docs"
  name       = "API documentation"
  href       = "https://example.com/petstore"
  visibility = "PUBLIC"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_hrid` (String) Human-readable ID of api
- `href` (String) The URL this link points to
- `hrid` (String) A unique human readable id identifying this resource. Requires replacement if changed.
- `name` (String) Display name of the link

### Optional

- `environment_id` (String) environment ID
- `location` (String) The path in the navigation hierarchy where this link should appear.
Resolved against the portal's navigation for a portal-attached link, and against the API's own
navigation for an API-attached link — the same path string therefore denotes a different tree
depending on which endpoint was used.
- `order` (Number) Display order relative to siblings at the same location
- `organization_id` (String) organization ID
- `visibility` (String) Whether the navigation entry is visible to anonymous portal visitors.
Optional in the Automation API for backward compatibility with clients that predate this field —
when omitted, the entry inherits from its parent (root entries default to PUBLIC).
A PUBLIC child under a PRIVATE parent is rejected.
must be one of ["PUBLIC", "PRIVATE"]

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource UUID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apim_api_link.external-docs
  id = jsonencode({
    api_hrid        = "petstore-api"
    environment_id  = "DEFAULT"
    hrid            = "external-docs"
    organization_id = "DEFAULT"
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apim_api_link.external-docs '{"api_hrid":"petstore-api","environment_id":"DEFAULT","hrid":"external-docs","organization_id":"DEFAULT"}'
```
